scope: Same B1 state-review continuation; one host-filled BoundSubmission field and selected-session/as-of-prefix association only
authority: Explicit LEAD ruling; independent of future C3 implementation; no new financial audit or approval chain

schema_change.earnings_delta: MUST current actual persisted OwnerSession.session_id, even if no read/call/complete participation
schema_change.no_owner_session: No qualified owner binding/submission; preserve actual failure/refuse, no future/fake ID

association.session_lookup: Exactly one authenticated OwnerSession by explicit ID; binding/ticket/attempt/current historical producer/normalized grant G and manifest M checked
association.read_hash_domain: Whole typed OwnerAccessRead.content_hash including session_id/sequence/binding/body; never body/header-only digest
association.credit_rule: ONLY actual reads/calls that are BOTH members of captured BoundSubmission prefix AND carry owner_session_id; later final records never add credit
association.full_prefix_forensics: Keep original exact cross-session prefix/all-successes accounting; filter only credit, not retained history
association.participation_when_present: Exact EarningsParticipation.session_id must equal owner_session_id, binding/G/M match, selected whole read hash and all coverage IDs captured and selected
association.participation_when_absent: Pointer still mandatory; recorded refusal evaluated against selected captured prefix only
association.temporal_limit: Pointer is host-filled hash-bound association, not independent wall-clock proof; do not infer current intent epoch from latest final session index

symbolic_fixture_policy: S1/S2/S3, C1/C2 and R1/R2 below are state-graph labels, NOT real runtime IDs/hashes, tool outputs or completion flags. Later tests materialize actual session/record prefixes under original source/access oracles. No symbolic record qualifies analytical acceptance.

events: Persist actual S1; actual bootstrap R1 and complete manifest/projection/citation calls C1
Reopen before retained step, no unresolved intent: persist fresh actual S2
I1 submission BEFORE any S2 bootstrap/call; capture full existing C1/R1 forensic prefix and owner_session_id=S2
Resolve I1 as refused participation_incomplete, unchanged journal snapshot; participation_sha256=None; no envelope/step/candidate/result
In same still-active S2 process: actually read R2 and complete new C2 traversals/citation checks
I2 submission captures full C1+C2 and R1+R2; owner_session_id=S2 and participation.session_id=S2
Existing valid review/core/settlement may then complete; final verifier must preserve earlier I1 refusal without later credit

I2.qualification: Only after actual complete selected coverage and existing review/core validation; no automatic valid flag
